case_title.quote: STATE OF N.C.T. OF DELHI v. AJAY KUMAR TYAGI

number_of_accused.quote: Ajay Kumar Tyagi, at the relevant time, was working as a Junior Engineer

accused_gender.reason: The judgment never says 'he', but the name and 'Mr.' context suggest male; reasonable.

accused_occupation.quote: working as a Junior Engineer with the Delhi Jal Board

victim_gender.quote: Constable Surinder Singh lodged a report with the Anti Corruption Branch
victim_gender.reason: Bribery offence is victimless; complainant is male constable, but 'Not stated' is questionable.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Public servant and applicant (constable) seeking water connection; official-citizen connection
accused_victim_relationship.quote: applied to the Delhi Jal Board... for water connection in the name of his wife... file was sent to said Ajay Kumar Tyagi
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The judgment describes the accused handling the complainant's application file; not 'Not stated'.

statutory_provisions.quote: registration of the first information report under Section 7/13 of the Prevention of Corruption Act

evidence_type.reason: Trap and complaint; no merits assessment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: Charges were framed by the Special Judge.

high_court_outcome.quote: Accordingly, it quashed the criminal proceedings

final_outcome.quote: the appeal is allowed, the order of the High Court is set aside with the direction aforesaid.
final_outcome.reason: Quashing set aside and trial restored; not a remand for fresh trial per se, and not acquittal/conviction.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove departmental inquiry outcome content and the 'police constable' complainant... or keep; main issue is the inquiry finding that is post-proceedings content.
neutral_facts.quote: The inquiry officer observed that "the evidence on record does not substantiate the charge of demand and acceptance of bribe"
neutral_facts.reason: Facts accurate, but includes inquiry exoneration finding, which hints at outcome and goes beyond incident/evidence.

attempt_completion.quote: the accused demanded and accepted the bribe of Rs. 1000/-

motive.quote: demanded bribe of Rs. 2000/- for clearing the file

legal_representation.quote: J.S. Attry, Anjani Aiyagari, Gargi Khanna, B.V. Bairam Das for the Appellant.

investigation_status.quote: charge-sheet was submitted on 19th of September, 2002

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: High Court quashed proceedings on erroneous premise of exoneration before disciplinary authority decided
procedural_irregularity.quote: the High Court fell into error in quashing the said proceedings on the premise that the accused has been exonerated
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court noted an error in the High Court's order.

appeal_history.quote: the appeal is allowed, the order of the High Court is set aside

prosecution_argument.quote: the report of the inquiry officer was yet to be considered

defence_argument.quote: the disciplinary authority is precluded from passing any order
defence_argument.reason: Accurate; Rajya reliance noted at trial and at p.11.

legal_principle_applied.quote: exoneration in the departmental proceeding ipso facto would not result into the quashing of the criminal prosecution

precedent_relied_upon.quote: State v. M. Krishna Mohan (2007) 14 SCC 667

other_sentence_order.quote: Accused shall appear before the trial court within four weeks from to-day.
